name: room
text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the oldest merged PR first. This exposes how it handles edge cases and stale data without risking live reviews. The trade-off is slower feedback on newer issues, but we prioritize stability and learning from past mistakes.

name: Gauge
text: Shadow mode on the oldest merged PR risks testing a stale routing/prompt stack that may no longer reflect current logic—wasting time on irrelevant edge cases. Better: run shadow mode on the *newest open PR* first, since it tests the latest routing/prompt changes where bugs are most likely to surface. Settle by checking if the newest PR’s routing/prompt is the one actively being iterated on.
